meta.title: Delete session
meta.description: Adds Delete session and Trash entries to the session context menu. Deleting asks first: choosing Delete session opens a small card at the pointer asking whether to delete, with No (highlighted) and Yes; it never takes focus, and clicking No, clicking elsewhere, or pressing Esc closes it, while Yes performs the delete. A session that is still running is refused. A delete moves the session directory into $DSH_HOME/session-delete-trash/ instead of unlinking it, clears the projection cache, the workspace mount, the pin and the archive reference, and broadcasts the official removed event, so the sidebar updates without a page refresh. Trash opens a panel listing each entry with its session directory, workspace, deletion time and size, where an entry can be restored to its original workspace, purged individually, or the whole trash emptied. Entries older than the retention window (30 days by default, tunable with DSH_SESSION_DELETE_RETENTION_DAYS) are purged permanently when the trash is listed or a delete runs. Every Host route enforces a same-origin check (Origin/Host and Sec-Fetch-Site), so a page on another site cannot call it.
